meta.description: Assembles per-request system-prompt augmentations for the Basic model. Runs an ordered list of augmentors in inlet (before the first assistant response, no tool call required) and appends their output as a system message. The first augmentor injects role-based suffixes keyed by OAuth group membership; the structure is built to host future dynamic augmentors (e.g. concept-of-the-day). Attach to the Basic model.

manifest.author: Adam Smith
manifest.description: Appends per-request system-prompt augmentations for the Basic model. Runs an ordered list of augmentors in inlet (server-side, no tool call); injects role and current chat-storage context. Attach to the Basic model. See issue #44 for the design rationale and v0.9.5 prompt-merge mechanics.
